domains.label: Exposure
domains.osce: Name the molecule before you name the symptom.

items.ask: Which agent — INN and brand if any? Dual GIP/GLP-1 or GLP-1 only?
Current dose, day of week, last titration, missed doses this month?
Licensed brand, compounding pharmacy, or grey/research peptide? Lot if compounded.
items.red_flag: grey market, self-reconstitution, unknown salt, stacked unlabelled vials

items.ask: Any other peptide, SGLT2, insulin, SU, diuretic, thyroxine, or second GLP-1?
items.red_flag: sema+tirzepatide stack, insulin/SU without hypo plan

items.ask: What is this prescribed for, as you understand it? Diabetes, weight, CV, or longevity?
Was off-label use, unknowns, and stopping rules discussed in writing?
Personal or family medullary thyroid cancer, MEN2, pregnancy, prior pancreatitis, known gastroparesis?
items.red_flag: MTC, MEN2, pregnancy, active pancreatitis

domains.label: Efficacy — metabolic
domains.osce: Rate, not just the number on the scale.

items.ask: Baseline weight, current, nadir, kg lost, weeks on drug, kg per week last month?
items.red_flag: >1.0–1.5 kg/week sustained — biliary and lean-mass risk

items.ask: Food noise, satiety, skipped meals, aversions, volume you can actually finish?
Home glucose, HbA1c, lipids, BP if known — and whether any of those were the actual goal.

domains.label: Body composition — longevity endpoint
domains.osce: Off-label longevity fails if the loss is muscle.

items.ask: Protein grams per day, relative to body weight? Actual intake, not intention.
items.red_flag: <0.8 g/kg/day during rapid loss

items.ask: Resistance training days per week? Load going up, down, or abandoned?
items.red_flag: no lifting while losing >0.5 kg/week

items.ask: Stairs, sit-to-stand, grip, walking speed — worse, same, better?
Face/hip volume, clothes vs scale, DXA/BIA if done, hair shedding?

domains.label: Gastrointestinal
domains.osce: Expected AE lives here. So does the miss that kills.

items.ask: Nausea or vomiting — which days relative to injection, can you keep fluids, CTCAE impact on eating?
Diarrhoea, constipation, alternating, blood, black stool?
Abdominal pain: epigastric, RUQ, peri-umbilical, diffuse; colicky vs constant; to the back?
items.red_flag: constant epigastric to back; colicky RUQ; obstipation with distension

items.ask: Food sitting for hours, vomiting yesterday’s meal, early satiety out of proportion?
items.red_flag: vomiting undigested food, progressive intolerance

items.ask: Oral fluid and calories yesterday and today. Urine output. Dizziness on standing.
items.red_flag: cannot keep fluids, oliguria, syncope

items.ask: Distension, obstipation, vomiting, inability to pass flatus?
items.red_flag: ileus / obstruction pattern

domains.label: Biliary and pancreas
domains.osce: Rapid loss seeds gallstones. Relentless pain is not ‘titrate slower’.

items.ask: RUQ or epigastric colic after fat, jaundice, pale stool, dark urine, prior stones?
items.red_flag: jaundice, fever + RUQ, persistent colic

items.ask: Severe constant epigastric pain to the back, vomiting, leaning forward, prior pancreatitis?
items.red_flag: acute pancreatitis pattern — ED, hold drug, lipase

domains.label: Volume and kidney
domains.osce: The AKI is usually the vomiting, not the peptide.

items.ask: Thirst, dry mouth, oliguria, standing dizziness, loop diuretic or SGLT2 on board?
items.red_flag: anuria, syncope, concurrent SGLT2 + poor intake

domains.label: Cardiovascular
domains.osce: Resting HR up a few bpm is class. Syncope is not.

items.ask: Resting heart rate change, palpitations, known ASCVD, orthostatic symptoms?

domains.label: Neuro-ophthalmic
domains.osce: Altitudinal curtain is not dry eye. Do not send them to Specsavers.

items.ask: Sudden visual change, field cut, curtain, painless monocular loss, new distortion?
items.red_flag: NAION / acute field defect — same-day ophthalmology

items.ask: If diabetic: last retinal screen, new floaters, known retinopathy?

domains.label: Psychiatric
domains.osce: FDA watch. Appetite loss is not an excuse to skip SI.

items.ask: Mood, anhedonia, irritability, flattening of reward beyond food?
items.red_flag: new major depressive syndrome after initiation

items.ask: Thoughts of being better off dead, suicidal ideation, plan, prior attempts?
items.red_flag: active SI — do not finish the weight review first

domains.label: Endocrine and boxed warning
domains.osce: The box is MTC / MEN2. Family ‘thyroid cancer’ is not specific until you ask which.

items.ask: Neck lump, hoarseness, dysphagia, watery diarrhoea, family MTC or MEN2 — which histology?
items.red_flag: neck mass + hoarseness, FHx MTC/MEN2

items.ask: Pregnancy, intention, contraception? GLP-1 is not a longevity drug in gestation.
items.red_flag: pregnant or trying

domains.label: Injection and product integrity
domains.osce: Compounded and grey product is a different drug until proven otherwise.

items.ask: Site reactions, nodules, infection, fever after injection, rotation?
items.red_flag: fever + nodule, abscess, systemic after grey vial

items.ask: Syringe markings, milligrams vs millilitres, multi-dose vial maths — any extra doses?
items.red_flag: compounded overdose (FDA: hospitalisations)

domains.label: Peri-operative aspiration
domains.osce: Delayed emptying. Anaesthetics need to know.

items.ask: Any procedure, endoscopy, or sedation planned? Last solid meal relative to injection?

domains.label: Plan
domains.osce: A verb, a clock, a 02:00 line.

items.ask: What would make you go to ED tonight — pain to the back, no urine, field cut, SI, jaundice.
